def test_cmdline(self):
    self.proc = subprocess.Popen([PYTHON, "-E"], stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(0.1)  # XXX: provisional, fix needed
    self.assertEqual(psutil.Process(self.proc.pid).cmdline, [PYTHON, "-E"])
